main.description: The publishing station attests that it serves this public MUXL blob. The record key is the blob's BDASL CID. Resolve the station DID's #streamplace service and call place.stream.playback.getVideoBlob there. The #atproto_pds service hosts the attestation, not the media. Independent stations may attest to the same blob.

blob.description: BLAKE-3 content hash (BDASL CID) of the blob.

size.description: Size of the blob in bytes.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the blob (e.g. video/mp4).
